claims.claim: The two-character sequences read by the verifier as percentages (0% 1% 2% 4% 6% 7% 8% 20% 22% 90% 91% 94% 95% 97% 99%) are NOT statistics. They are byte-pair artifacts of UTF-8 percent-encoded Hebrew text inside the example data.gov.il query URLs (for example q=%D7%AA%D7%9C). In percent-encoding, each byte is written as a percent sign followed by two hexadecimal digits, so digit pairs that follow a percent sign in an encoded Hebrew string surface as phantom percentages and carry no quantitative meaning.
claims.raw_snippet: Percent-encoding is a mechanism to encode 8-bit characters that have specific meaning in the context of URLs. It is sometimes called URL encoding. The encoding consists of a substitution: A '%' followed by the hexadecimal representation of the ASCII value of the replaced character.

claims.claim: CKAN DataStore search actions: /action/datastore_search returns up to 100 rows by default, and /action/datastore_search_sql executes SQL queries against the DataStore using the PostgreSQL engine. datastore_search_sql must be explicitly enabled and is commonly disabled on public portals.
claims.raw_snippet: The datastore_search action allows you to search data in a resource. By default 100 rows are returned - see the limit parameter for more info. A DataStore resource that belongs to a private CKAN resource can only be read by you if you have access to the CKAN resource and send the appropriate authorization.

claims.claim: The live data.gov.il dataset list is at https://data.gov.il/datasets (plural); the singular /dataset serves a client-side 404 error page
datastore_search_sql on data.gov.il is NOT disabled: SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, sum() and LIMIT all return HTTP 200 with success:true and real records (live probe 2026-08-27)

The data.gov.il WAF blocks SQL containing injection-signature substrings (count(, 1=1, UNION) with an HTML 404 page of about 1.4 kB, not a JSON error and not a 403; sum(1) is the working substitute for count(*) and returns the same aggregate (live probe 2026-08-27: sum(1) over the public-transport resource = 65953, matching the datastore total)
Live row counts verified 2026-08-27 by asserting on the response body: vehicles 4168353, public-transport 65953, mosdot 119761, amutot 75680

No rate limiting observed on data.gov.il: 25 rapid sequential datastore_search calls completed in 6.5 seconds, all returning HTTP 200, and about 60 calls across one session drew no throttling (live probe 2026-08-27)

data.gov.il's organization_list?all_fields=true returns name, title, image_url and resources_count, and does NOT return CKAN's display_name or package_count (both come back null), which is why the bundled script must read title/resources_count
CBS locality codes: Tel Aviv-Yafo 5000, Haifa 4000, Jerusalem 3000, verified against the CBS localities resource 5c78e9fa-c2e2-4771-93ff-7f400a12f7ba on 2026-08-27
Deep offset paging still works on data.gov.il: offset=500000 on the 4.17M-row vehicle resource returned HTTP 200 with a record (live probe 2026-08-27), so there is no hard offset cap
CBS locality codes are stored as type text with a trailing space: filters={'סמל_ישוב':'4000'} returns success:true with total 0, while '4000 ' returns Haifa (live probe 2026-08-27)

The same locality is spelled three ways across the two resources the skill joins: localities has 'תל אביב - יפו ' with a trailing space, mosdot has 'תל אביב - יפו' in שם ישוב and 'תל אביב-יפו' in שם רשות (live probe 2026-08-27)

The mosdot resource is a per-year panel covering only 2011 to 2015 (21474 / 23419 / 23583 / 25046 / 26239 rows per year), so its 119,761 total is five years of the same institutions and it holds nothing after 2015 (live probe 2026-08-27)
Date columns in the amutot resource are type text in DD/MM/YYYY, so sort=<date> desc is lexicographic and returns 31/12/2025 above any January 2026 row (live probe 2026-08-27)

Real-estate transactions, GTFS and most CBS series are not on data.gov.il: q=nadlan returns count 0, fq=organization:taxes-authority returns 4 customs datasets, q=gtfs returns 2 unrelated datasets, and fq=organization:lamas returns 14 datasets with no population table (live probe 2026-08-27)

A genuine SQL error returns JSON with HTTP 409 and a psycopg2 message, distinguishing it from the 1376-byte HTML 404 generic error page, which is shared by a WAF match, an undefined action name and a non-existent resource_id (live probe 2026-08-27)
records_format=csv returns result.records as a headerless CSV string; the column names live only in result.fields, in order (live probe 2026-08-27)
datastore_active is independent of format: the mosdot resource is XLSX and still datastore_active true (live probe 2026-08-27)
Filtering the mosdot resource to a single year through datastore_search filters works and returns total 26239 for 2015, matching the GROUP BY per-year breakdown (live probe 2026-08-27)

The data.gov.il WAF blocks datastore_search_sql that references a Hebrew-named column in a predicate or a function (WHERE "שנה"=2015 and WHERE TRIM("סמל_ישוב")='4000' both return the HTML 404), while SELECT, GROUP BY and ORDER BY to_date on the same Hebrew columns return 200, and WHERE on a Latin column or on _id returns 200 (live probes 2026-08-27)

ORDER BY to_date("תאריך רישום עמותה",'DD/MM/YYYY') DESC on the amutot resource returns 26/08/2026 at the top, so casting text dates in ORDER BY works even on a Hebrew-named column (live probe 2026-08-27)
